column5: Look: "Stardust Storybook". A calm dusk-blue to cream gradient background. The pressed letter shows big, centred and warm golden, glows, then breaks into drifting gold and white stardust that gathers into a flat, rounded 2D vector creature with friendly colours (green Stegosaurus with orange plates, a purple T‑Rex, a blue Ankylosaurus…). The creature idles with a gentle breathing bob. Signature detail: the stardust takes the letter's outline before flowing into the creature. Sparkle, never strobe. Every figure is drawn: no emoji, no plain circles. *(provisional)*
